releases.summary: Exact Snapshot History Mirror Gate: persistence source correction mirrors into snapshot history only on an exact source timestamp match. The prior same-session/same-bucket fallback was removed; missing or unmatched timestamps fail closed and are recorded instead of mutating another intrahour snapshot. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.

Runtime Error Boundary: captures TAG500-owned script-load failures and critical JavaScript exceptions, records them in Data Integrity, and makes Executive Mode fail closed when runtime safety is compromised. Network-style promise failures remain warnings rather than automatic model failures. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.

Late-Bound Outermost Runtime Boundary: Runtime Safety now attaches after the complete render-wrapper chain exists, automatically re-attaches if later overlays replace render, and catches failures thrown by the outermost UI/runtime layers. Critical runtime errors remain fail-closed; transient network failures remain warnings. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.

RTH→AH Volume Handoff: direct ahVolume remains preferred, but when it is absent TAG500 may derive After-Hours Volume Participation/Takeover from the same-day central R15 volume baseline versus the current total volume only when the extended-hours volume field is demonstrably moving and non-frozen. Missing/contradictory baselines remain fail-closed. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.
